title: generator's out
description: What the generator gives as it ends: its result, its last message, and its Made.

result.description: The fixed word it gives by running python3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/lane/result.py generator <result>. done: the deliverable is made, and its Made written. asks: the design leaves a point open. lacks: something outside the work stops it, such as a missing tool. The routes go on by this word.

reply.description: For asks, the point, with its recommendation; for lacks, what it lacks; each beginning with the line For the person:, which the main conversation puts to the person as given. For done, nothing more.

made.description: The Made, in the file that its run value made names, written before it gives done.

decisions.description: Where it carries out each decision of its Cut: the decision's path, and the places in the deliverable.

more.description: Where it makes each More kept good: the best practice and the necessary condition, which key the More kept, and the places in the deliverable.

best_practice.description: The kind of the best practice, as the More kept names it.

settled.description: Each point it settled without asking, with its ground, which the main conversation puts up with the deliverable.
